data.name: Hirok
data.gender_notes: Hirok is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit word 'Hira' meaning mountain and 'K' meaning shining or radiant, Hirok is a name that symbolizes the strength and courage of a mountain. It is a name that is often given to boys born during a time when the sun is shining brightly, bringing joy and vitality to all around. The name Hirok carries the meaning “Shining Mountain, Radiant, Brave” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Hirok usually hope their child will grow to embody shining mountain, radiant, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hirok is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality. It is a name that is believed to bring good fortune and success to those who bear it. It is also a name that is associated with the god Vishnu, who is the preserver of the universe. Hirok is a name that is believed to inspire courage and strength, helping those who bear it to overcome any challenges that come their way.
data.etymology: Hirok belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Shining Mountain, Radiant, Brave.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hirok total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hirok carries a rich cultural significance in Hindu and Sanskrit traditions. It is a name that embodies the powerful, unyielding and steadfast nature of a mountain, often seen as a symbol of stability, strength, and resilience. In Hindu mythology, mountains are considered sacred, and the gods and goddesses are said to reside on them. A name like Hirok, therefore, represents a deep connection to these ancient traditions and values.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Hirok represents the inner strength and resilience of an individual, just like a mountain. It is a reminder that no matter what challenges life may bring, one can remain steadfast and strong, grounded in their beliefs and values. Moreover, the shining or radiant 'K' in the name symbolizes the inner light or the divine spark within each one of us, urging us to illuminate our own life path and fulfill our spiritual potential. Overall, Hirok is a profoundly meaningful name that inspires a sense of inner strength, courage, and spiritual growth for the individual who carries it.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Hirok in Hindu culture symbolizes radiance and brilliance, derived from the Sanskrit root hi meaning 'sun' and rok meaning 'shining' or 'radiating'. Thus, Hirok represents the innate light and vitality within an individual, constantly illuminating their path and inspiring confidence.
